blocks.title: In feesad ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab inhein global warming mein gases ka hissa kehti hai. Is size ke adaad aam taur par kul greenhouse emissions (carbon dioxide ke barabar) mein har gas ka hissa batate hain jo mulk ke hisaab se badalta hai; fi molecule methane aur fluorinated gases carbon dioxide se kaheen zyada garmi qaid karti hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Qudrati greenhouse effect: suraj ki shuaain (solar radiation) greenhouse gases (CO2, H2O, CH4) ki patli teh aur atmosphere se guzar kar zameen tak; zameen se garmi wapas uthti hai, zyada garmi khala mein nikal jati aur kam garmi wapas lotti. Insani barhaya hua effect: zyada greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O) ki moti teh; kam garmi khala mein nikalti aur zyada garmi wapas zameen par lotti.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.9: Qudrati aur insani barhaya hua greenhouse effect (global warming ki aik wajah) (kitab ki Figure 25.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Global warming: insani sargarmiyon se zameen ki ausat satahi hararat mein lamba izafa; IPCC (2023) 1850-1900 ke muqable mein taqreeban 1.1 C garmi batata hai.

Garmi ki lehrein: Jacobabad aur Sibi jaise shehar duniya ki sab se garam jaghon mein hain; 50 C se oopar jism maamool ki hararat qaim nahi rakh sakta aur loo lagna jaan lewa ho sakta hai. Maweshi garmi ka dabao jhelte, garam sardiyon mein keere aur machhar zyada jeete, khushk saali barhti aur jangal ki aag ka imkaan barhta hai.

Sailab: garam hawa zyada nami rakhti, jis se be-tarteeb, tez barish aur 'turbo-charged' monsoon jo jangalat, gharon aur faslon ko nuqsan, mitti ka katao aur kami, paani ki aaloodgi aur paani se phailne wali bimariyan laate hain.

Glaciers ka pighalna: Pakistan mein qutbi ilaqon ke baad sab se zyada glaciers hain; Baltoro aur Batura jaise glaciers tezi se pighal rahe hain jis se glacial lake outburst sailab aate hain, aur agar yeh khatam ho gaye to Indus sookh sakta hai.
Samandar ki satah ka barhna aur sahili katao: pighalti barf aur garam hota paani samandar ko oopar karta; Thatta aur Badin mein samandar ka paani zarai zameen ko namkeen daldal bana raha hai.
Ghizai adam tahaffuz: phool aane par garmi gandum aur chawal ki paidawar ghatati, aur garmi se sookhi mitti registan banti hai (desertification).
Ecosystem mein khalal: darja hararat aur barish ki tez tabdeeliyan species ko jagah badalne ya hijrat par majboor karti aur maadoom bhi kar sakti hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baatein: sailab, GLOF aur badal phatna
blocks.text: Kitab June 2025 ke Pakistan ke sailabon ko, jo tez pre-monsoon barish, glacial lake outburst floods aur badal phatne se aaye, 1,000 se zyada amwaat, 3 million se zyada logon ki be-dakhli aur 200,000 se zyada gharon ki tabahi ka sabab batati hai. Glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) glacier ki jheel ka qudrati bandh, maslan barf ka, tootne par paani ka achanak nikalna hai; is ka paani 100 km se zyada tak ja sakta hai. Badal phatna (cloudburst) chhote ilaqe par thore waqt mein achanak bohat tez barish hai.

blocks.prompt: Garam fiza zyada shadeed sailab kyun laati hai?
blocks.explanation: Garam hawa zyada nami rakhti hai, is liye barish zyada shadeed aur be-tarteeb jhatkon mein aati aur monsoon taqatwar ho jata hai.

items: GHGs: CO2, CH4, N2O, fluorinated gases.
Asraat: garmi (taqreeban 1.1 C), garmi ki lehrein, sailab, glaciers ka pighalna aur GLOFs, samandar ki satah, ghizai adam tahaffuz, ecosystem mein khalal.
